title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 13 in F-sharp major

character.text: Galant dance fugue (gavotte) with a concerto-like plan

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 2 and a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted and the opening of countersubject 2. Bass: free counterpoint. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 44–52).
sections.leads: Between two statements in F♯ major

sections.label: Subject in F♯ major, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (4 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (9 times), in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Returns in Episode 4 (bars 56–64).
sections.leads: From F♯ major to C♯ major

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 12–20), with soprano and alto exchanged, a fourth higher. Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted and the opening of countersubject 2. Alto: the opening of countersubject 2 (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From D♯ minor to B major; perfect cadence in G♯ minor at bar 46; perfect cadence in B major at bar 52

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bars 24–32), with soprano and alto exchanged, a fifth lower. Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (4 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (9 times), in a sequence rising by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: From B major to F♯ major

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of the subject.
sections.leads: From F♯ major to C♯ major

sections.label: Subject in C♯ major, rhythm varied (Alto)
Episode 6
sections.summary: Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a third every half bar.
sections.leads: From C♯ major to F♯ major

sections.label: Coda
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in F♯ major at bar 84
